title: Restrained bar heated past yield
line: A nonlinear thermal-stress FEA study of a steel bar restrained at both ends and heated 150 K past first yield.
description: A steel bar, 16 x 16 mm and 200 mm long, held between rigid walls and heated 150 K. The walls stop it growing, so it carries a uniform axial stress that reaches yield at 109 K. A quarter of the bar is solved in load steps with J2 plasticity, and the study returns the stress and displacement at full heating.
thumbnailAlt: Von Mises stress in a restrained steel bar heated past yield, solved in RunMat
